source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting results that contradict the hypothesis in a psychology research report

1. Start with the research records.
2.
completion:
Decide whether the method, questions or sample was unsuitable. Compare methods and results from the literature to identify problems.
3. Unless there are obvious issues, describe the results objectively. If there are issues with method, questions or sample, describe the results and then the problems with method, question or sample.

# Further guidance:
This set of instructions can be printed and kept as a record.

A printed copy can be used to note where your work as a psychology student or researcher deviated from the instructions.

# Documentation in text

The following example shows an accurate description of literature in the form of a table.

Details of the literature follows the heading Literature are in a Table. Figure numbers and titles are specified below each figure.

Paragraphs in the text are numbered.

Paragraph 1: This is the first paragraph of text. A table is given below. The contents of the table and the numbering of figures in the table are explained
